types.name: AlignDistributePanel
types.description: AGENT-CONTRACT (WP-042/CAN-21): the host supplies stable object IDs and owns canonical bounds, geometry previews, commit and undo. Requests carry string IDs so 64-bit CanvasObjectIds remain exact across QML/JS.

signals.name: operationRequested
signals.parameters: string operation, var selectedIds, string referenceMode, string keyObjectId, real spacing

types.name: AppWindow
types.description: AGENT-CONTRACT (docs/controls.md): the application window of a document app. Four bands, top to bottom: the `menuBar` (a Tk.MenuBar), the `toolBars` (any items, usually Tk.ToolBar, stacked in a column), the content (the default property), then the optional `findBar` and the `statusBar` at the very bottom. Every band is as tall as its content and the content band takes the rest. The background is the theme's bg role, and the window palette mirrors the theme so native popups (file dialogs off-portal, tooltips of foreign controls) inherit it.  Sizing: set width/height once in the component. Never resize a window after it is shown from inside the app (the QindaQt desktop's window containers own grouped geometry, ADR-0117).

types.name: ArtboardView
types.description: AGENT-CONTRACT (docs/canvas.md#artboards): the host owns board records and commits; this layer only maps, paints, and reports document-space gestures.

signals.name: boardArrangePreview
signals.parameters: string boardId, point startDocumentPoint, point currentDocumentPoint

signals.name: boardResizePreview
signals.parameters: string boardId, point startDocumentPoint, point currentDocumentPoint

types.name: AssetFilmstrip
types.description: The outgoing head and incoming tail frame. Frame extraction is supplied by an injected AssetBackend; the default file backend reports Unsupported.

types.name: AssetThumbnail
types.description: A Thumbnail whose image lifetime is owned by AssetProvider. The adapter keeps the base tile's fixed geometry while the request loads or fails.

types.name: AssetWaveform
types.description: Requests width-reduced peaks and forwards only provider data to Waveform.

types.name: Badge
types.description: AGENT-CONTRACT (docs/controls.md): a 16px count/status pill in micro semibold text, radius full. `variant` picks the status tint; `dot` collapses it to an 8px status dot.

types.name: Box
types.description: AGENT-CONTRACT: the CSS box. Background colour, uniform or per-side border, radius, padding, and a padding box (`contentItem`) that one child fills automatically (`fill: true`, the default) or several children anchor inside. Implicit size is the content's implicit size plus padding and border, so a Box in a Flex or Grid asks for exactly what it holds. Per-side borders (borderLeft/Top/Right/Bottom >= 0) are drawn as square edge rectangles. `radius` rounds the background only in that mode; it does not clip the edges, so their corners remain square. A uniform border honours `radius`.

types.name: BreadcrumbBar
types.description: Stable-ID hierarchy navigation. Horizontal overflow is a real viewport; labels are presentation only and never participate in identity lookup.

types.name: Button
types.description: AGENT-CONTRACT (docs/controls.md): the text button. 24px (small 20, large 28), radius sm, body font, padding-x space.md. Variants: "default" (controlBg + controlBorder, text slightly muted at rest as Sloom's theme-button), "accent" (accent fill, accentContrast text), "ghost" (no fill or border at rest), "outline" (border only), "danger" (danger fill). `busy` swaps the icon for a Spinner and disables the button. Consumers express capability through `available`, not `enabled`, because the busy state owns the enabled binding.

types.name: CalendarPicker
types.description: LocaleService supplies calendar-correct month data and ISO Gregorian dates.

types.name: CandlestickView
types.description: AGENT-CONTRACT (docs/financial-displays.md): the model owns exact UTC time, price validation and host session meaning; this view uses equal session slots.

types.name: CanvasView
types.description: AGENT-CONTRACT (docs/controls.md#canvasview, docs/canvas.md): the spatial document surface. Bind `document` (a Tk.CanvasDocument or any CanvasDocumentAdapter), `toolController` (a Tk.ToolController) and, for synchronized views, one shared `viewState` (a Tk.CanvasViewState). Navigation changes only the view pose; every document change goes through the tool controller's one-commit-per-gesture path.  AGENT-NOTE: the C++ Tk.CanvasSurface is the root so its API needs no passthroughs (same pattern as Sparkline over Graph). This file supplies what C++ must not: Theme roles, accessibility and the overlay slot. Tk.Viewport is unchanged and remains the right choice for a scrolled page that needs no rotation, tools or picking (docs/canvas.md#viewport).

types.name: Caption
types.description: 10px secondary text (the original's text-[10px] / text-xs helpers): hints, readouts, list metadata. Muted by default.

types.name: Card
types.description: A raised content card: the panelAlt surface with a 1px border and a 6px radius, md padding. `interactive` adds hover/pressed tinting and the `clicked` signal (from Box); `tooltip` names it for users and assistive technology. `selected` paints the accent border.

types.name: CheckBox
types.description: AGENT-CONTRACT (docs/controls.md): a 14px box (small 12), radius xs, accent-filled with a `check` glyph when checked, a `minus` glyph when partially checked (tristate). Row height 20 (small 16), body text.

types.name: Chip
types.description: AGENT-CONTRACT (docs/controls.md): the Sloom pill. Measured from the running original: 32px tall (small 28), radius 6, 1px border, 8px horizontal padding, icon and label 6px apart, label and glyph in the accent colour. `rounded` turns it into the 36px fully round island action with 10px padding. `emphasis` follows the original's three weights: "plain" for most actions, "tinted" for one that is on, "solid" for the primary. `active` (alias of checked) lights the border.

types.name: ClipItem
types.description: One visible timeline clip: body, label, peaks from the media seam, trim affordances, lock and selection state, or a summary of merged tiny clips.  AGENT-CONTRACT: a ClipItem is presentation. EditTimeline supplies its geometry and exact tick strings from TimelineViewport rows and routes the pointer through TimelineViewport.hitTest, so a clip that scrolls out while it is dragged loses nothing: the gesture belongs to the lane, not to this delegate. The item only emits intents (select, nudge, activate); the model applies them. It releases its media request when pooled or destroyed.

types.name: ColorButton
types.description: AGENT-CONTRACT (docs/controls.md): a toolbar button showing the current `color` as a swatch with a chevron; clicking opens a Tk.Popover with a Tk.ColorSwatches over `colors`. Picking a swatch sets `color` and emits colorSelected(color); "Custom…" emits customRequested() (the host opens its picker and sets `color` itself). Control height (24; `small` 20). objectNames "colorButtonSwatch", "colorButtonPopover".

types.name: ColorField
types.description: AGENT-CONTRACT (docs/controls.md): a 24px (small 20) colour readout: a 16px swatch over a checkerboard (so alpha shows) beside an editable hex value ("#rrggbb" or "#aarrggbb"; "#rgb" and bare hex are accepted on entry). A changed, valid user commit emits colorEdited(color); applyHex() and owner color assignment are silent. Swatch tap, key or accessible press emits pickRequested() for the host to open its picker. objectNames "colorHex" and "colorSwatch" identify the interactive parts.

types.name: ColorSwatches
types.description: AGENT-CONTRACT (docs/controls.md): a grid of named colour swatches. `colors` is a list of colour strings or of {name, color}; the entry equal to `current` shows an accent ring. Tapping (or Space/Enter on a focused swatch) emits selected(color); the optional "Custom…" button emits customRequested() for the host to open a full picker. Sized to its content: `columns` swatches per row, 16px Compact artwork, and cells at least `Theme.size.controlSm` so Touch targets use the 48px floor.

types.name: ComboBox
types.description: AGENT-CONTRACT (docs/controls.md): the 24px (small 20) picker on inputBg with a chevron, whose popup (objectName "comboPopup") is a Menu-styled list with host-bounded height and scrolling. Rows fit scaled text and expose selected state; `textRole` and `iconRole` read the model. A JS array of strings needs no roles. `placeholderText` shows while currentIndex is -1. `editable` turns the content into a text input, as T.ComboBox defines.

types.name: CommandBar
types.description: Model-driven command strip. Items retain stable IDs across user ordering; registry projections provide live enabled/checked state.

types.name: CommandButton
types.description: Toolbar friendly button backed by one semantic command. The contained Button remains the sole pointer, keyboard and accessibility activation surface; all accepted activations call CommandBinding.trigger() once.

types.name: CommandPalette
types.description: AGENT-CONTRACT: the Ctrl+K palette. `commands` is a list of {id, label, shortcut, section, iconName, keywords, enabled}; typing filters by a case-insensitive substring over label and keywords, results are grouped by section (first-appearance order) under overline rows, and ↑/↓ + Enter (or a click/accessibility press) emit `activated(id)` and close. `enabled: false` keeps a row visible but skips and guards it. Top-centred at 12% of the window height, width min(560, window - 32).

types.name: CurveEditor
types.description: AGENT-CONTRACT: CurveEditor presents host-owned stable-ID knots and sampled normalized points. It emits selection and edit lifecycle requests; the host owns canonical coordinates, interpolation, constraints, transactions, and undo. A host may replace `knots` during a preview; the editor keeps pointer ownership at the root so delegate replacement cannot lose an active drag.

properties.name: knots
properties.default: []       // [{id, x, y, label?}], normalized x/y in 0..1

properties.name: samples
properties.default: []     // [{x, y}], already evaluated by the host

signals.name: movePreview
signals.parameters: string id, real x, real y

types.name: DataTable
types.description: AGENT-CONTRACT: a dense, virtualised, sortable table. `columns` is a list of Tk.TableColumn. `model` is a JS array of objects, or any model that exposes `get(index)` returning one record (QML ListModel does; a C++ model needs a Q_INVOKABLE QVariantMap get(int)). Rows are Theme.size.row tall and only the visible ones exist, so a table of ten thousand processes costs the same as a table of thirty.  AGENT-NOTE: records are fetched with recordAt(index) rather than read from the delegate's `model`/`modelData` context properties, because those differ by model kind -- a JS array delegate gets `modelData` and no `model`, a QAbstractItemModel delegate gets role properties and no `modelData` -- and a cell that has to work for formatters, ramps and custom delegates alike cannot branch on which one happens to exist. get() is only ever called for rows that are actually on screen.  AGENT-GUARD: the table never sorts or filters. Clicking a header emits `sortRequested(key, order)` and nothing moves until the owner applies it to its model. A table that sorted a JS array in place would silently reorder the caller's data and disagree with a C++ proxy's own ordering.  objectNames: tableHeader, tableBody, headerCell_<key>, headerFocusRing_<key>, tableRow.

types.name: DateTimeField
types.description: Canonical value is an ISO date string for all-day values and ISO UTC for instants. LocaleService owns parsing/formatting; ambiguity is user-resolved.

types.name: Dialog
types.description: AGENT-CONTRACT: a modal dialog on the popover surface behind a dim scrim: overline title (+ caption subtitle), the dialog's content as its default property, and a footer with a secondary and a primary button (`primaryText` / `secondaryText`; `destructive` paints the primary in the danger variant). Escape rejects, Enter accepts. `standardButtons` from T.Dialog is deliberately unused: the footer is ours, so set `footer:` to replace it wholesale instead. `tertiaryText` adds a third, left-aligned button (Save / Discard / Cancel dialogs); `primaryEnabled: false` greys the primary and blocks Enter.

types.name: DiffView
types.description: AGENT-CONTRACT (docs/diff-view.md): model computes aligned, read-only rows. Buttons only request a decision through DiffModel's host adapter.

signals.name: decisionRequested
signals.parameters: string requestId, string hunkId, string action

types.name: DistributionPlot
types.description: AGENT-CONTRACT (docs/distribution-plot.md): all statistical values and interval meanings come from DistributionModel. This view only projects them.

types.name: Divider
types.description: A 1px rule. Horizontal by default; `vertical: true` for toolbars. Inside a Flex it takes no main-axis space beyond its thickness and stretches on the cross axis.

types.name: DockDivider
types.description: The resizable seam between two dock lanes, between a lane and the canvas, or between two slots of a lane (`share: true`). Pointer, keyboard and accessible operations report deltas; the host applies them to the DockModel, so this item never owns placement or extent state. Left/Right and Up/Down follow the seam axis; focused seams show a themed outline so keyboard users can tell which boundary they will move.

types.name: DockDropOverlay
types.description: Drop targets while a panel is being dragged: translucent strips at the host edges (dock into that zone), a preview of the rectangle the panel would take, and a ghost that follows the pointer. Hit testing lives in DockHost (it knows the frames); this only draws `host.dropTarget`.

types.name: DockFloating
types.description: The floating layer: every floating panel of the model, drawn above the dock zones in z-order. A frame's rectangle is read live from the model, so header drags (moveFloating), the eight resize handles (setFloatingRect) and raising (bringToFront) never rebuild it. `shade` (collapse to the header) is host-side state that survives rebuilds. AGENT-GUARD: never name this id `layer`: Item.layer is a property of every delegate, and the scope object's property shadows the id.

types.name: DockFrame
types.description: AGENT-CONTRACT: one docked slot: Tk.Panel chrome around the content of one panel, or a tab strip plus the contents of a whole group. The frame is created from the host's structural snapshot (which panels sit here) and reads the live facts (active tab, collapsed, share) from the model through `host.slotInfo`, so a seam drag or a tab click never rebuilds it. Content items are seated (reparented) into per-panel containers and reclaimed on teardown; they are never re-created.

types.name: DockHost
types.description: AGENT-CONTRACT: the dockable-panel host. It draws what Tk.DockModel says and reports gestures back; it never holds arrangement state.  Tk.DockHost { model: Tk.DockModel { storageKey: "myapp/image" } workspace: "image" canvas: Item { ... }                  // the fixed centre Tk.DockPanel { panelId: "layers"; title: "Layers"; zone: "right"; ... } }  Geometry: top and bottom zones span the full width; left and right zones are columns of lanes beside a centre column; the "center" zone stacks rows above the canvas inside that column; "overlay" panels sit over the canvas at its top-right; floating panels sit above everything.  AGENT-GUARD: structure (which panels sit in which lane/slot) is a snapshot assigned only when it changes, so Repeaters rebuild frames only for real moves. Extents, shares, active tabs, collapsed flags and floating rectangles are read live through `gen`-dependent helpers — a seam drag must never destroy the seam being dragged. Before a zone is rebuilt its frames reclaim their content into the declarations (see DockFrame).

types.name: DockPanel
types.description: AGENT-CONTRACT: a panel declaration inside a Tk.DockHost. Nothing here is drawn. The host registers `definition()` with the DockModel and moves `contentItem` (the Item holding the declared children) into whatever frame the arrangement puts the panel in — docked, tabbed, floating — so the content keeps its state (scroll position, selection, text) across every move. A hidden panel's content simply lives here, invisible.  Tk.DockPanel { panelId: "layers"; title: "Layers"; zone: "right" Tk.Scroll { ... } }

types.name: DockPlacementDialog
types.description: AGENT-CONTRACT: drafts describe intent only; DockModel owns arrangement. Host ownership keeps this dialog alive when applying rebuilds panel frames.

types.name: DockTabStrip
types.description: The tab row of a slot that holds several panels (a tab group). 22px, caption font, accent underline on the active tab. Click activates (DockModel.activateInGroup), a horizontal drag reorders on release (moveInGroup), a drag that leaves the strip vertically tears the panel out (host.beginDrag), right-click opens the group menu.

types.name: DockZone
types.description: One dock zone: lanes side by side (left/right zones: columns of stacked slots) or stacked (top/bottom/center zones: rows of slots), each lane followed (or, for right/bottom, preceded) by the seam that resizes it. Structure comes from `lanes` (the host's snapshot); every size is read live from the model so seam drags never rebuild anything.

types.name: DocumentTabs
types.description: Lifecycle-aware view tabs. Rows are rebuilt from DocumentManager state; close/reorder requests never mutate or infer document identity locally.

types.name: EditTimeline
types.description: A virtualized multitrack edit timeline: ruler, marker lane, track headers, clip lanes, edit range and scrollbars over one TimelineModel.  AGENT-CONTRACT: TimelineModel owns placement, history and policy; TimelineViewport owns only the view (exact origin tick, zoom, scroll) and the bounded delegate rows. This control keeps the current track/clip IDs and routes pointer, keyboard, numeric and assistive input to the same typed model edits, so each accepted gesture is one undo step and a rejected or cancelled one leaves the document unchanged. Clip selection lives in a SelectionModel by stable ID and survives reorder, moves and scrolling.

types.name: EditTimelineHeaders
types.description: The track-header column of an EditTimeline: one TrackHeader per visible track row, scrolled with the lanes, and the resize/reorder sessions.  AGENT-CONTRACT: header rows come from TimelineViewport, so they share the lanes' vertical scroll and virtualization. A resize or reorder drag is one TimelineModel session previewed live (the rows move before anything is committed); release commits one undo step. A lost grab, Escape, a replaced model or destruction cancels it, and the rest of that press does nothing. Reorder targets are computed from the committed layout captured at the start, so the previewed order never feeds back into its own destination. AGENT-NOTE: the column's own MouseArea, under headers that run with gestures: false, owns press, drag and double-click, like the lanes' pointer controller: a previewed reorder or an autoscroll recycles header delegates, and a gesture held by a delegate would die with it.

types.name: EditTimelineLanes
types.description: The track-lane surface of an EditTimeline: lane stripes, clip delegates, the edit range, playhead, snap guide and the single pointer controller.  AGENT-NOTE: one MouseArea owns every clip gesture and hit-tests through TimelineViewport instead of per-delegate handlers. Delegates are recycled as clips scroll in and out (and a dragged clip may leave the viewport during autoscroll); a gesture held by a delegate would die with it. AGENT-GUARD: a drag is exactly one TimelineModel edit session, owned by internal.sessionModel (`model` may already be a replacement). Every exit path (release, Escape, lost grab, model invalidation, a replaced model, destruction) either commits or cancels that session; never leave internal.operationId set on return.

signals.name: clipPressed
signals.parameters: string clipId, string trackId, int modifiers

types.name: EditableGrid
types.description: AGENT-CONTRACT: EditableGridModel owns cell data, transactions, section geometry/order, frozen counts and range identity. This view owns only the active cell/editor and the two viewport offsets.

signals.name: editCommitted
signals.parameters: string rowId, string columnId, var value

types.name: EmptyState
types.description: What an empty list or panel says out loud: a muted icon, an overline title, a wrapping caption and optional actions, centred in the space it is given. An empty panel with nothing in it reads as a broken one.

types.name: ExportDialog
types.description: Export delegates format decisions and stale/conflict guards to FormatRegistry.

types.name: ExpressionField
types.description: AGENT-CONTRACT: evaluator returns canonical numeric values and source offsets; PropertyBinding owns the only document transaction. Bad drafts never change the last committed value.

signals.name: expressionCommitted
signals.parameters: string expression, real canonicalValue, string dimension

types.name: FilePathField
types.description: AGENT-CONTRACT: URI strings are canonical document values. Validation inspects local files only; remote availability is explicitly unknown. Browse and validation responses are accepted only for the current request.

types.name: Filmstrip
types.description: The frames of a clip, in order — most usefully its first and its last.  AGENT-NOTE: an editor scanning a timeline is reading the cut, and a cut is two frames: what the outgoing clip ends on and what the incoming one starts on. A strip of evenly spaced frames looks richer and answers a question nobody asked; head and tail is the default here for that reason, with more frames available when there is width to spend.  AGENT-CONTRACT: `frames` is a list of {source, caption} in display order. The strip never reflows them — it shows as many as fit from the front and the final one last, so the tail frame is always visible however narrow the clip gets. A strip that dropped the tail would hide half of every cut.

types.name: FilterBar
types.description: Composes typed filter leaves; owner receives a version-independent predicate tree and decides when to submit it.

types.name: FindReplaceBar
types.description: Revision-tagged find/replace over a host-owned text document. The service performs document edits and groups replace-all into one undo operation.

types.name: FontFeaturesEditor
types.description: FontCatalog supplies face-level metadata and cmap coverage; a host binding supplies editable formatting state. Glyph shaping support is not inferred.

types.name: FontPicker
types.description: Provider metadata is authoritative. The specimen makes fallback explicit; no coverage or feature capability is inferred from the rendered glyphs.

types.name: FormGroup
types.description: Labeled, collapsible form section. `validationItems` entries may provide {item, invalid, pending}; async pending is reported separately from errors.

types.name: GanttView
types.description: AGENT-CONTRACT: one recycled row carries the task label and interval, so timeline and grid identity both come from GanttTaskModel.taskId. The owner shares a SelectionModel with its DataTable and applies any grid sort to a source/proxy model before handing it to both views.

types.name: GuideLayer
types.description: AGENT-CONTRACT (WP-041): the host supplies guideData records with stable `id`, `orientation` (horizontal/vertical), and document-space `position`. This layer paints/maps guides and reports requests; guide persistence, snapping, and authoritative movement remain with the host model.

types.name: HeaderView
types.description: AGENT-CONTRACT: section positions, order and size come from EditableGridModel. The view receives viewport geometry and never keeps a parallel size map.

types.name: Heading
types.description: A title line. `level` 1 is display size, 2 is title, 3 is large.

types.name: HistoryView
types.description: Navigates the authoritative per-document undo history. The service owns grouping, clean markers, branch invalidation and history retention.

types.name: IconButton
types.description: A square icon-only button at control height (24px; `small` is 20px). Ghost by default (no fill at rest), tinted on hover, accent when `checked`. `tooltip` sets the accessible name and the hover tooltip.

types.name: ImportDialog
types.description: Import is format-registry driven; adoption occurs only after job success.

types.name: Inspector
types.description: Schema driven property view. Each descriptor supplies label, binding, editorType (number/vector/text), units and optional group metadata.

types.name: Island
types.description: A floating, fully rounded control island that sits over the canvas (Sloom's `theme-control` glass pills): the canvas at 72% behind a 1px low-contrast border, 6px vertical and 8px horizontal padding, children in a centred row. Anchor it over the work area, not inside a toolbar.

types.name: KeyCap
types.description: A keyboard shortcut, drawn as keys rather than written as a string.  AGENT-NOTE: "Ctrl+Shift+K" in running text is read as prose and skimmed past; the same shortcut as three caps is read as keys and remembered. Menus, command palettes and shortcut sheets all want this, and all three were hand-rolling it.  AGENT-CONTRACT: `sequence` is a portable Qt key string ("Ctrl+Shift+K"). The separator is normalised here rather than by callers, so a sheet and a menu cannot disagree about whether it is "+" or a space.  AGENT-NOTE: an Item wraps the Flex because Flex owns its implicit size (docs/layout.md); the Item reports the row's, so the strip slots into menus and palette rows like any other control. Rule 4 forbids the QtQuick Row positioner this control was rooted on.

types.name: KeyValue
types.description: A 22px readout row: caption key on the left, value right-aligned in mono (the original's "Sequence Info" block). `accent` lights the value.

types.name: Label
types.description: Body text in the theme's face and colour. Elides when a layout narrows it; set `wrapMode` to wrap instead. `muted`/`disabled`/`accent` switch the colour role so call sites never name a colour.

types.name: LayerTree
types.description: A flat layer list bound to CanvasDocument's current layer facade. Hierarchy, artboards and reordering require model support not present yet.

types.name: ListRow
types.description: AGENT-CONTRACT: a dense list row. 22px (28 with `secondaryText`), text in body size, optional icon, `leading`/`trailing` slots, hover tint, `selected` paints the selection role, `active` lights the text in the accent. Right-clicks arrive as `rightClicked(point)` for a context menu; left click, keyboard and assistive press share the template click operation. Owner selection updates are silent. objectNames: rowText, rowSecondary and rowFocusRing.

types.name: MarkerLane
types.description: Editable cues and regions above timeline tracks.  AGENT-CONTRACT: markers are TimelineModel records with stable IDs and exact positions; this lane draws TimelineViewport marker rows and edits through model transactions only. A drag is one MoveMarker session: Escape, a lost grab or a replaced model cancels it and restores the committed position, and the rest of that press does nothing; release commits one undo step. Keyboard: Left/Right choose the previous/next marker, Alt+Left/Right move it one grid step, Delete removes it, F2 or Return renames it and M adds one at the playhead.

types.name: Menu
types.description: AGENT-CONTRACT: a real T.Menu — popup(), cascading submenus, keyboard navigation and mnemonics all come from the template. Visuals: the popover surface with a 1px popover border, 6px radius, 22px items. Use Tk.MenuItem / Tk.MenuSeparator as children; `title` names it in a Tk.MenuBar or as a submenu entry.

types.name: MenuBar
types.description: A 22px menu bar on the surface colour: small-font titles, the open one filled with the active control tint. Children are Tk.Menu { title }.

types.name: MenuButton
types.description: Button whose activation only opens a command menu. The selected row may update the button's label and icon while registry state remains authoritative.

types.name: MenuItem
types.description: One 22px menu entry: optional icon (or a check mark when checkable and checked, a dot when `radio`), small-font label, a muted caption `shortcut` on the right, a chevron for a submenu. `danger` paints the label in the danger role.

types.name: MenuSeparator
types.description: A 1px divider between groups of menu items with xs margins.

types.name: MessageDialog
types.description: AGENT-CONTRACT (docs/controls.md): a Tk.Dialog for a question or a warning: a status icon, wrapping body `text`, and up to three buttons — `primaryText` (accepted), `secondaryText` (rejected), `tertiaryText` (tertiary), e.g. Save / Cancel / Discard. `variant` picks the icon and its colour: "info", "question", "warning", "danger"; `destructive` paints the primary in the danger variant.

types.name: MixedValueField
types.description: Shared state and explicit transaction helpers for typed editors. Merely focusing the child never changes a mixed value; callers commit deliberately.

types.name: Mono
types.description: Monospace readout text: timecodes, coordinates, hashes, values that must line up in columns.

types.name: NavigationRail
types.description: Persistent application navigation. Route state remains owned by the host.

types.name: NavigatorView
types.description: AGENT-CONTRACT (docs/canvas.md#synchronized-views): mainView owns the authoritative navigation pose; this overview owns only its fitted preview. Pointer navigation changes mainView.viewState center, never document data.

types.name: Notice
types.description: An inline message bar: tinted background, a 2px left edge and an icon in the status colour of `variant` ("info", "success", "warning", "danger"), optional title, wrapping text, an `actions` slot and an optional dismiss button. Never modal; place it where the message applies.

types.name: NotificationCenter
types.description: Persistent notices are owned by the injected bounded model. Action IDs are emitted to the host for command/context validation rather than invoked here.

types.name: NumberField
types.description: AGENT-CONTRACT (docs/controls.md): the inspector number field. 24px (small 20), mono digits, optional inline `label` ("W"), `prefix`/`suffix` readouts, ▲▼ step buttons on hover (always visible in Touch), and scrubbing: dragging horizontally on the label or the field changes the value by `scrubSensitivity` units per pixel (Shift ×10, Alt ×0.1). Arrow keys step (Shift ×10); Ctrl+wheel steps. `value` is always clamped to [from, to] and rounded to `decimals`. `defaultValue`/`reset()` provide explicit reset semantics; mixed state is resolved only by a valid user commit. Invalid drafts stay visible and `inputInvalid` reports them. `valueModified(value)` fires for user edits and reset, while a programmatic `value = x` is silent. objectNames: "numberInput", "numberLabel", "numberStepUp", "numberStepDown".

types.name: OverflowToolBar
types.description: Deterministic measured overflow. Each command has one visible presentation at a time; hidden measurement rows never take focus or receive input.

types.name: Overline
types.description: The uppercase, letter-spaced, semibold caption that heads every grouped block of a Sloom panel: 10px, 0.18em tracking, muted. The typographic signature of the dense style; use it for section titles and panel headers, never for body copy.

types.name: Panel
types.description: AGENT-CONTRACT: panel chrome. A 24px header (grip, uppercase title, trailing actions, collapse / float / close buttons) over a padded body. The panel only reports intent (collapseToggled, floatRequested, closeRequested); a host such as DockFrame decides what happens. Measured from Sloom Studio: header 24px, title 10px semibold uppercase, 1px divider, floating panels get a 6px radius and an accent border.

types.name: PillSwitcher
types.description: AGENT-CONTRACT (docs/controls.md): a compact, fully rounded page switcher for top bars. Entries are strings or {text, iconName, value, tooltip, accent, objectName}; programmatic currentIndex changes are silent and activated(index, value) reports user changes only.

types.name: PivotView
types.description: Read-only, bounded rendering of QueryController's result snapshot. Every displayed aggregate can request drill-through using source-row provenance.

properties.default: qsTr("Pivot results; activate a value to inspect its source rows")

types.name: PolarView
types.description: AGENT-CONTRACT: plot and table consume the same full-resolution model. Numeric angles and ordered categories are separate axis modes; neither the delegate nor the CSV path invents angular units or category order.

types.name: Popover
types.description: AGENT-CONTRACT: a non-modal popup placed next to `anchorItem` on the side `placement` names ("bottom", "top", "left", "right"), kept inside the window. It lives in the Overlay, so it is never clipped by a panel or a Scroll. open()/close() as any Popup; `opened`/`closed` are the template's signals.

types.name: PreferencesDialog
types.description: Searchable, staged editor for SettingsModel descriptors. The model owns validation, defaults, apply/cancel and restart semantics.

types.name: ProgressBar
types.description: AGENT-CONTRACT (docs/controls.md): a 3px (thin: 2px) accent bar on a divider-coloured track, radius full. `indeterminate` slides a third-width segment; the animation stays off when reduced motion zeroes the motion ladder (a 0ms looping animation would spin the CPU).

types.name: PromptDialog
types.description: AGENT-CONTRACT (docs/controls.md): a Tk.Dialog that asks for one line of text (a name, a title). `label` captions the field, `text` is the value (preset it before open()), Enter accepts, Escape rejects; with `acceptEmpty: false` (the default) an empty or blank value greys OK and blocks Enter. The field takes focus and selects its text on open. objectName "promptField" on the field.

types.name: PropertyGroup
types.description: A titled block of PropertyRows: a SectionHeader (collapsible), the rows in a column with xs gaps, and a closing divider. Collapsing hides the rows and keeps the header, as the original's inspector sections do.

types.name: PropertyRow
types.description: AGENT-CONTRACT: one inspector row. A muted caption label in a fixed column (Theme.size.labelWidth) and an editor that fills the rest; the row is at least Theme.size.row (22) tall so stacked rows align whatever the editor is. `hint` adds a caption line under the editor. The editor is the row's default content; a single editor is stretched (Box rules).

types.name: QueryBuilder
types.description: Typed visual editor for QueryEngine's version-1 JSON contract. This control never builds executable text; the controller validates and runs the AST.

properties.name: tooltip
properties.default: qsTr("Build a typed query and pivot layout")

types.name: QueryTransformPanel
types.description: Editor surface for the bounded detail projection and one typed join.

properties.name: tooltip
properties.default: qsTr("Join, project and sort typed query fields")

types.name: RadioButton
types.description: AGENT-CONTRACT (docs/controls.md): a 14px circle (small 12) with an accent dot when checked; exclusive within its parent like any T.RadioButton. Row height 20.

types.name: RangeSelectionOverlay
types.description: AGENT-CONTRACT: endpoints live in EditableGridModel by stable ID; this overlay only resolves the current geometry and never stores selection state.

types.name: RangeSlider
types.description: Two handles on one track, for a band rather than a point.  AGENT-CONTRACT (docs/controls-media.md): matches Slider's metrics — a 2px track, a 10px handle (8px small), in a 16px (14px) row — so a range and a value sit on the same inspector grid. `rangeModified(first, second)` fires on user moves from either handle.  AGENT-NOTE: the handles are deliberately allowed to meet and cross-clamp rather than being blocked at each other. A user dragging the upper handle down past the lower one means "I want this band to start here", and a slider that simply refuses feels broken; T.RangeSlider's own clamping keeps first <= second, so the band collapses rather than inverting.

types.name: ResourceTable
types.description: AGENT-CONTRACT: ResourcePlanModel owns allocation, capacity, unit, conflict and history state; this view owns stable-id focus and pixel scroll offsets.

signals.name: editCommitted
signals.parameters: string resourceId, string bucketId, real allocation

types.name: Ribbon
types.description: Model-driven contextual command ribbon. Group commands keep stable model IDs.

signals.name: itemRequested
signals.parameters: string tabId, string groupId, string itemId

types.name: Ruler
types.description: AGENT-CONTRACT: a tick ruler for canvases and timelines. `origin` is the pixel position (along the ruler) of unit 0, `pixelsPerUnit` the pixels per unit; major ticks every `majorEvery` units carry micro labels, minor ticks every `minorEvery`. `cursorPosition` (px, -1 none) draws the accent cursor line. It repaints when the theme changes so colours never go stale. 22px thick.  Markers (A7): `markers` is a list of {id, position (px along the ruler), kind: "indent-first" | "indent-left" | "indent-right" | "tab", draggable}. A first-line marker hangs from the top edge, the indents and tabs stand on the bottom edge. Dragging a draggable marker emits markerMoved(id, position) for every move (the host writes the value back and the marker follows through `markers`); a double-click on the bottom half where no marker sits emits tabAdded(position); dragging a tab off the ruler (below it) emits tabRemoved(id) on release. `band` shades the surface the ruler measures (paper) and `activeBand` the part of it that is live (the text column), both as [start, end] px.

types.name: Scroll
types.description: AGENT-CONTRACT: CSS `overflow: auto`. The single content child is sized to its implicit size on a scrolling axis and to the viewport on a hidden axis, so `overflowX: Scroll.Hidden` (the default) makes a Column wrap to the width and scroll vertically. Scrollbars are overlays and take no layout space. D-021 defines nested wheel/key handoff, hard bounds and focus reveal through inner and outer viewports.

types.name: ScrollBar
types.description: Thin overlay scrollbar: an 8px rounded thumb in the accent tint over a track that only appears on hover, as the original's WebKit scrollbar styling does. Attach with `T.ScrollBar.vertical: Tk.ScrollBar {}`.

types.name: SearchField
types.description: AGENT-CONTRACT (docs/controls.md): a TextField with a search glyph, a clear button, Escape-to-clear, and `searched(text)` emitted `debounce` milliseconds after the last user edit (and immediately on Enter). Host-side text synchronization does not start a search.

types.name: SectionHeader
types.description: The heading row of a grouped block inside a panel: an Overline title, an optional count, trailing actions, and an optional disclosure chevron that toggles `collapsed` (bind the block's `visible` to !collapsed). AGENT-NOTE: an Item wraps the Flex because Flex owns its implicit size; the row height comes from Theme.size.row, not from the text.

types.name: Segmented
types.description: AGENT-CONTRACT (docs/controls.md): one 24px row of joined segments (small 20). `model` is a list of strings or {text, iconName, value, tooltip}; the selected segment paints controlActiveBg, the rest are ghost. Each segment is objectName "segment_<index>". `activated(index)` fires on a user click (not on programmatic currentIndex changes).

types.name: SelectionOverlay
types.description: AGENT-CONTRACT (docs/canvas.md#overlays, WP-041): the canvas host supplies document-space selectionCorners, or document-space selectionBounds as a fallback, and a CanvasView surface. This item owns only view-space presentation and gesture reporting; a geometry adapter owns validation, snapping, preview and commit.

types.name: ShortcutEditor
types.description: Captures portable shortcut sequences into a local edit set. The map validates the complete proposed override set before persistence/activation.

properties.name: validation
properties.default: ({ ok: false, conflicts: [], error: qsTr("Shortcut service unavailable") })

types.name: Slider
types.description: AGENT-CONTRACT (docs/controls.md): a 2px track with an accent fill and a 10px round handle (8px small) in a 16px (14px) row, so it sits inside a 24px inspector row. `showValue` adds a mono readout on the right. `valueModified(value)` fires on user moves (pointer and keyboard).

types.name: Spacer
types.description: Flexible space inside a Flex row or column (CSS `margin-left: auto` / `flex: 1` on an empty div). `size` gives it a fixed extent instead.

types.name: Sparkline
types.description: A single-series Graph sized for a table cell or a label row: no grid, no baseline, no axis -- just the shape of a history. Feed it with append().  AGENT-NOTE: this is a wrapper rather than its own C++ item so that the one plotting implementation (and its two drawing paths) serves both sizes. A row's sparkline and a panel's full graph cannot disagree about a trace.

types.name: Spinner
types.description: AGENT-CONTRACT (docs/controls.md): a 14px rotating arc in the accent colour (Lucide's loader-circle glyph). Stops rotating, but stays visible, when reduced motion zeroes the motion ladder.

types.name: SplitButton
types.description: Primary command plus a distinct menu segment. The command and menu have separate activation surfaces so the arrow can never invoke the command.

types.name: Splitter
types.description: Resizable panes with a 4px seam (Theme.size.seam) that lights in the accent when hovered or dragged. Children size themselves with the template's attached properties (`SplitView.preferredWidth`, `SplitView.minimumWidth`, `SplitView.fillWidth`; import `QtQuick.Templates as T` or `QtQuick.Controls as QQC` for the attached type). `saveState()`/`restoreState()` come from the template.

types.name: StatusBar
types.description: The compact 22px strip along the bottom of a window: caption-sized fields in a row on the surface colour under a 1px top rule. Touch keeps the same content rule and reserves its themed control target below it.

types.name: StatusField
types.description: One entry of a StatusBar: optional icon and caption text. Actionable fields use a real template button; readouts can opt out and remain static text.

types.name: Switch
types.description: AGENT-CONTRACT (docs/controls.md): a 26x14 track (small 22x12), radius full, accent when on, with a 10px (8px) knob that slides. Row height 20. The track is derived from the icon sizes so it scales with density.

types.name: TabStrip
types.description: AGENT-CONTRACT: a dense tab row. `model` is a list of strings or of {text, iconName, closable, tooltip}; `currentIndex` is the open tab. The strip never owns pages: bind a page's `visible` to the index. 22px tall (Theme.size.tab), caption font; the active tab shows the text colour with a 2px accent underline ("underline") or a filled pill.

types.name: TableColumn
types.description: AGENT-CONTRACT: one column of a Tk.DataTable. `key` names the model role (QAbstractItemModel) or the object property (JS array) the cell reads, and is also what `sortRequested` reports -- a DataTable never sorts a model itself, because only the model knows whether "3.9" outranks "12" as a number or as text.  A column is either fixed (`width`) or elastic (`flex` > 0). Elastic columns share whatever the fixed ones leave, never shrinking below `minWidth`.

types.name: TargetDisplay
types.description: AGENT-CONTRACT (docs/financial-displays.md): band labels, direction, target and range are validated by TargetModel; drawing infers no category.

types.name: TaskCenter
types.description: Read-only presentation of JobModel. Workers own execution; retry is a host request so the application can revalidate inputs before creating a new job.

types.name: TextArea
types.description: AGENT-CONTRACT (docs/controls.md): a wrapping multi-line field on inputBg that is at least `rows` lines tall and grows with its text. Place it in a Tk.Scroll when the text can outgrow its panel.

types.name: TextField
types.description: AGENT-CONTRACT (docs/controls.md): the 24px (small 20) single-line field on inputBg with a 1px inputBorder; focus paints inputFocusBorder plus the focus ring; `error` paints the danger colour. Optional leading `iconName`, a `clearable` × button (objectName "fieldClear") and a `trailing` slot for buttons or units. `cleared()` fires when the user clears the field through the button or Escape.

types.name: Thumbnail
types.description: A media tile that is honest about not having a picture yet.  A bin row, a filmstrip frame and a poster frame all want the same thing: an image that may not exist, may still be loading, may have failed, and must occupy its space either way so the row beneath does not jump when it arrives.  AGENT-CONTRACT: `source` may be empty, may point at an asynchronous image provider, and may fail. Each of those is a state a caller can see through `state`, and each draws something: the kind icon while empty or loading, a muted alert glyph on failure. It never draws nothing, and it never resizes itself when the image lands.

types.name: TimeRuler
types.description: A time scale whose tick density follows the zoom, not the caller.  AGENT-NOTE: every timeline that hand-rolls a ruler ends up with ticks that are unreadably dense when zoomed out and comically sparse when zoomed in, because the step is a constant somebody picked at one zoom level. The step here is chosen from a 1/2/5/10 ladder against the pixels available per label, which is the rule that keeps a chart axis readable at any scale.  AGENT-CONTRACT: `pixelsPerUnit` and `originUnits` are the caller's scroll state; this draws them and never owns them. A ruler that kept its own scroll position would drift from the track area beneath it, and the drift is invisible until someone measures a cut against it.

types.name: TimeSelection
types.description: An edit, loop or punch range over timeline lanes, with precise endpoints.  AGENT-CONTRACT: startTicks/endTicks are owner state (decimal tick strings). A pointer, keyboard or numeric change is a draft until it commits once through rangeCommitted; rangeCanceled restores the committed range. While an endpoint is dragged the other endpoint is the anchor: dragging past it swaps which handle is the start and the range stays normalized (start <= end). An empty range commits only when allowEmpty is true; otherwise the drag is rejected and the committed range is restored. All tick arithmetic happens in TimelineModel, never in QML Numbers.

types.name: TimelineTimingEditor
types.description: Numeric entry for one clip (start, length, source offset) or one range (start, end) of an EditTimeline.  AGENT-CONTRACT: fields show and parse text in the owner's display mode through TimelineModel (formatTicks/parseTicks for positions, formatDuration/parseDuration for lengths), so no value passes through a QML Number. A field the user did not change keeps its exact value rather than the display-quantized text (a timecode shows whole frames only). In clip mode Apply submits one SetClipTiming edit guarded by the revision the editor opened at, so values the user never saw are never written back; in range mode it emits rangeEdited for the owner's TimeSelection to commit. An unparsable field or a rejection keeps the popover open with the reason and changes nothing. Escape or Cancel closes it without an edit.

types.name: Toast
types.description: Transient alert that remains until timeout or explicit dismissal. Focus or pointer hover pauses the themed countdown so its action stays reachable.

types.name: TokenField
types.description: AGENT-CONTRACT: committed tokens are {id,label,value,valid}; IDs survive reorder and label edits. completionProvider.request(query) returns a request ID, then finished(id,{candidates:[{label,value,valid}]}). Only the current ID, draft and edit revision may publish suggestions. Completion never edits a committed token; choosing a suggestion makes one PropertyBinding edit.

signals.name: tokenReordered
signals.parameters: string id, int from, int to

types.name: ToolBar
types.description: AGENT-CONTRACT (docs/controls.md): a 36px chrome bar (compact: 28) on the surface colour with a 1px edge, children in a centred row with space.sm gaps. Put Chips, Buttons, Segmented, ToolSeparator and Spacer in it. `edge` draws the border on "bottom" (default), "top" or "none".

types.name: ToolSeparator
types.description: A vertical rule between toolbar groups: 1px, inset 6px from the bar's top and bottom. AGENT-NOTE: an Item that stretches on the cross axis rather than a bare Divider, so the inset is measured from the bar and not from the row's centred content height.

types.name: ToolShelf
types.description: Tool selector for canvas and editing contexts. Ownership of the effective tool stays with the host; temporary tools are an explicit push/pop request.

types.name: ToolTip
types.description: Dense tooltip: caption text on the popover surface, 600ms delay. Declare a child `Tk.ToolTip { text: qsTr("Undo"); visible: hovered }` on its owner; the attached form creates the QtQuick.Controls style tooltip instead.

types.name: TrackHeader
types.description: The controls for one timeline track: name, kind, mute/solo/arm/lock/hide, routing summary, a resize seam and a reorder grip.  AGENT-CONTRACT: every value here is owner state from TimelineModel through TimelineViewport track rows. Toggles, rename, resize and reorder emit requests keyed by trackId; nothing changes until the model applies them, so a rejected request leaves the header showing the committed state. With gestures: false the header leaves press, drag and double-click on its background and resize seam to the owner (EditTimelineHeaders handles them for the whole column, so a drag outlives a recycled header delegate).

signals.name: propertyRequested
signals.parameters: string trackId, string property, var value

types.name: TransformEditor
types.description: Transform parts remain separately typed properties. A host adapter owns coordinate conventions and any matrix decomposition policy.

types.name: TransportBar
types.description: AGENT-CONTRACT: every visual state and exact readout comes from the acknowledged TransportModel snapshot. This bar contains no media timer. Space toggles play/stop; R record, L loop, P punch, Home locate zero; Left/Right seek by one TimeMap second using exact signed sample strings.

types.name: TreeRow
types.description: AGENT-CONTRACT (docs/controls.md): a ListRow with a depth indent and a disclosure chevron. Clicking the chevron (or double-clicking the row) toggles `expanded` and emits `expansionToggled`; a nonexpandable, noneditable leaf uses the inherited `clicked` action for pointer, keyboard and accessible activation. The row never owns disclosed children. AGENT-NOTE: the signal is not `toggled(bool)` as docs/controls.md first said: AbstractButton already owns a `toggled()` signal and QML refuses the override.

types.name: UnitField
types.description: Numeric display boundary for canonical values. displayUnit entries use {id, label, scale, offset}: display = (canonical - offset) / scale.

types.name: VectorField
types.description: Edits one component through PropertyBinding.updateComponent so each target retains its own untouched components, including mixed selections.

types.name: Viewport
types.description: AGENT-CONTRACT (docs/controls.md): a zoomable, scrollable document viewport. The single child is the document surface (a page, a slide, an artboard) sized by ITS implicit size in document units; the viewport scales it by `zoom`, centres it when it is narrower than the view, pads it by `contentPadding`, scrolls both axes, and paints the canvas role behind it. Ctrl+wheel zooms about the cursor, Shift+wheel scrolls horizontally, a middle-button drag pans. `fitMode` "width" / "page" re-fits on every resize until the user zooms by hand. At a pan edge, ordinary wheel input reaches an ancestor Scroll (D-021).  AGENT-GUARD: zoom is a view transform only. The child keeps its own coordinate space; map pointer positions with `toContent(point)`.

signals.name: moveRequested
signals.parameters: string id, string parentId, int position

types.name: Waveform
types.description: An audio envelope: peak magnitude per column, mirrored about a centre line.  AGENT-NOTE: this draws its own shape rather than wrapping Tk.Graph, which was tried first and does not fit. Graph fills from the plot EDGE -- GraphMesh::baseline() returns `plot.mirrored ? 0.0 : plot.height` -- so two mirrored series fill to the top and bottom rather than meeting at zero, and a quiet clip renders as tall as a loud one. That is exactly the judgement an editor reads a waveform to make, so the wrapper was abandoned rather than papered over. Giving Graph a fill-to-zero mode would be the better toolkit answer, but it means changing two rendering paths that existing consumers already depend on.  AGENT-CONTRACT: `peaks` are magnitudes in 0..1, one per column, already reduced by the caller. A waveform must be summarised at the width it is drawn; handing this a million samples to reduce on every repaint is the mistake this contract exists to prevent.

types.name: ZoomControl
types.description: The zoom readout of a canvas toolbar: a minus button, the mono percent (click to reset to 100%), a plus button. Stepping walks `presets` when they are given, else adds `step`. Fits inside an Island.

types.description: AGENT-CONTRACT (docs/canvas.md#document-adapter): the document side of the canvas boundary. Views, hit testing, tools and renderers read documents only through this interface, and change them only through commit(). An application with its own scene model implements it; CanvasDocument is the in-memory reference implementation used by tests and examples. It reads the surface transform, the ToolController and the document; it never changes any of them. WP-041 replaces the selection part with SelectionOverlay/TransformHandles against the same contracts.

types.name: CanvasSurface

It maps input to document coordinates, routes pointer gestures to a ToolController, keeps navigation in a CanvasViewState, and draws through a RenderSurfaceAdapter. It owns no document state.  AGENT-GUARD: updatePaintNode runs on the render thread. It may read only m_frame (an immutable snapshot produced in updatePolish) and plain values copied under sync. Never read the document, the tool controller or the adapter there.

types.description: AGENT-CONTRACT (docs/canvas.md#synchronized-views): the navigation pose of one or more CanvasViews. Views that share one CanvasViewState show the same document point at their centres with the same zoom and rotation; each keeps its own size and device pixel ratio. Navigation writes only this object -- never the document.

types.name: ChartAxis

DateTime values are signed 64-bit UTC milliseconds and labels use the declared time zone. Use mapUtc(), never a QML Number, for temporal data.

types.name: ChartDataset
types.description: Bounded QML ingestion boundary. Date coordinates enter as decimal strings, never as JavaScript Numbers; model rows retain the source point IDs.

types.name: ChartHistogramSelection

types.name: CommandContext

types.name: CommandRegistry
types.description: Descriptors are global to an application; handlers are owned by live scope instances. One invocation resolves one most-specific handler and executes it once, regardless of whether the request came from menu, button or palette.

types.name: Density
types.description: AGENT-CONTRACT: the one density authority of a process. Theme's `space` and `size` groups multiply their base values by scale(); controls read those groups and never Density directly, so a density change re-resolves every metric through a single path (Theme::rescale). Compact is the measured Sloom Studio scale and the default; Comfortable is 20% roomier; Touch is for pen/finger use.

types.description: A host may back a large or structured comparison with indexed/paged storage. Only requested regions and hunks are fetched; ownership stays with the host.

types.name: DiffTransactionAdapter
types.description: AGENT-CONTRACT: the host owns source documents and the transaction. Returning true means the request was queued, not committed. Cancellation must prevent a queued operation from committing; a completed operation is reported by supplying new document snapshots/revisions to DiffModel.

types.name: DistributionModel
types.description: AGENT-CONTRACT (docs/distribution-plot.md): records own finite source values, a declared common unit, and optional explicitly named intervals. The model computes statistics; the QML view only projects them.

types.name: DockModel
types.description: AGENT-CONTRACT: the arrangement authority for dockable panels. It owns where every panel is; DockHost (QML) only draws that and reports gestures. The model is zone-based, as Sloom Studio's dockablePanel contract and QindaStudio's PanelLayoutController are: a panel is docked, floating, collapsed or hidden; a docked panel sits in one zone (left, right, top, bottom, center, overlay), in one lane of that zone (lanes are columns for side zones, rows for the others), at an order inside the lane, optionally sharing a tab group with neighbours. Arrangements are per workspace, persist across runs (`storageKey`), and can be saved by name. Every operation is idempotent on invalid ids.  Compatibility: method names follow PanelLayoutController so QindaStudio can adopt this model with a find-and-replace; dockBeside/lanes/shares are the additions that make drag-to-dock and lane splitting possible.

types.description: AGENT-CONTRACT: feeds the QindaQt desktop's QST-1 semantic tokens into QindaTK's Theme. Instantiate one in the application root:  import QindaTK.QindaQt QindaQtTheme { }  Every republish of the Tokens singleton (theme switch, accessibility change) re-derives QindaTK's colour roles, so both the desktop's own controls and QindaTK's read the same palette. When the Tokens singleton reports not ready, the toolkit keeps its current preset instead of painting invented colours on top of an unpublished theme.
